bio: Enjoy a mouth-watering Afternoon Tea at Weetwood Hall, tuck into this British tradition whilst surrounded by nine acres of picturesque woodland and gardens the ideal location of those looking for a relaxing countryside escape.  Enjoy your Afternoon Tea in the Convive Mediterranean restaurant which offers a contemporary and stylish setting with outdoor seating for those looking to dine al fresco in the summer months.  Their Afternoon Tea menu includes a selection of finger sandwiches- smoked salmon and crème fraiche, accompanied with delicious home baked scones and an array of sweet treats. Feeling indulgent?  Add a glass of Prosecco to your Afternoon Tea for £4.95!  Weetwood Hall is located on Leeds northern ring road with several of Yorkshire's popular attractions close by including The Yorkshire Dales, First Direct Arena and Trinity Leeds.
